name: Hetzner servers, as recorded 2026-09-08
description: The three Hetzner servers the hcloud recording (hcloud-servers.json) was taken from on 2026-09-08, as testenv/estate.json described them until they were decommissioned (#634): the recording's counterpart, so the shape battery in assets_ipc.rs has servers to match by origin key. Not the estate -- that is testenv/estate.json -- and not a witness of anything live: `just estate-live` is that.

assets.name: Hetzner Cloud nbg1
assets.description: The three servers that host the opt-in real products, one product per server, provisioned by `provision.sh`.

assets.name: knobas-teamcity
assets.description: The TeamCity server's host. Reached over SSH; nothing but 22 and ICMP is open, which is why its monitor is a ping.

assets.name: knobas-jira
assets.description: Jira's host. cpx22 (AMD) rather than a cx type: Jira's start is single-threaded and took 72 s here against 147 s on a cx23.
